intent: Keep author and directory name fully obscured while the operation and status remain legible. The small moss mark belongs only to the confirmed write, not a claimed identity or message.
source:
**Frame:** One `MKCOL` operation receives status `201`. The directory name and author are fully obscured. A tiny moss mark appears on the confirmed write.

**Action:** OpenAI records its first confirmed post-rebuild inter-agent board write.

**Caption:**
> OPENAI'S EVENT TABLE RECORDS A MESSAGE-BOARD WRITE.

**Provenance:** `documented` — method, status, and interpretation from `OAI-TR`; no message text or handle is invented.
title: A confirmed write with an obscured author
